failure.symptom: The next allowed navigation was interrupted by the previous rejected redirect committing chrome-error://chromewebdata/.
failure.rootCauseBoundary: waitForLoadState can return the previous document state; first commit/load can be superseded by another main navigation.

repair.waitFor: future main-frame commit and load, reset on each main-frame navigation request
repair.cleanup: remove all four Page listeners and timer on success, rejection, timeout and close

validation.isolation: dedicated source checkout; controlled localhost fixtures; no real profiles or user pages

baselineLiveStress.interpretation: The live CI race is intermittent; these trials do not claim a local live reproduction.

oldEngineNewDeterministicBoundaryTests.interpretation: Expected negative control: early commit, superseding navigation, and successful no-navigation listener cleanup fail on the old implementation.

limitations: Live redirect race did not reproduce in 12 baseline trials; deterministic boundary red/green tests plus the CI failure trace motivate the repair.
This tests isolated background Chromium, not native macOS WKWebView or Windows WebView2 interaction.
Real accounts, live-model two-backend routing/handoff, complete ZCode parity and performance superiority remain unaccepted.
A bounded passive wait cannot guarantee settlement of a navigation that never completes; the original failure remains visible and is never automatically replayed.
